verdict.rationale: Square has its own headless programmatic surface: REST APIs with an official TypeScript SDK (e.g. `client.payments.create`), webhooks, and an MCP server. Its Sandbox environment allows automated runs without live money, which fits CI-style testing. However, nothing documents an official CLI, CI-specific guidance, or non-interactive auth and credential handling for pipelines. missing for 10: official CLI, documented CI/pipeline integration and headless auth guidance, hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
